---
title: "Question corpus"
subtitle: "Thirty unchanged STACK exports, with a measured adapter boundary"
---

These are 30 native STACK XML questions from the upstream library. Each question below has a local XML download, its pinned upstream source, and a result from the current adapter. **Only the six questions whose authored tests passed on all three replayed seeds have interactive cards.** The others remain available for inspection, with the observed mismatch or unsupported feature shown explicitly.

The [reproducible baseline](questions/corpus/baseline.json) reports **6 passed**, **6 with test mismatches**, and **18 blocked** (11 at import, 7 at instantiation). It retained **73 authored test cases** and replayed **72 seed/case combinations** across 12 instantiated questions; 27 combinations disagreed. Passing those bounded checks is evidence for the listed seeds, not complete STACK/Maxima parity.

**Attribution and reuse.** Questions are from [STACK / maths/moodle-qtype_stack](https://github.com/maths/moodle-qtype_stack), pinned at commit [`10d323311b7f39fb7b092dd10ce75f7d8632f525`](https://github.com/maths/moodle-qtype_stack/commit/10d323311b7f39fb7b092dd10ce75f7d8632f525). The unchanged question exports carry the [CC BY-SA 4.0 license](https://github.com/maths/moodle-qtype_stack/blob/10d323311b7f39fb7b092dd10ce75f7d8632f525/samplequestions/COPYING.txt), also [included locally](questions/corpus/COPYING.txt); see each pinned source link below. The [manifest](questions/corpus/manifest.json) records the exact upstream path and SHA-256 for every XML file.
